description: Flat metadata schema for individual marine microbial genomic sequencing samples collected across ocean regions, capturing spatial, environmental, and biome context for diversity analyses.

sample_id.descr: Unique identifier for the individual microbial sampling record or sequencing sample.

collection_date.descr: Date when the sample was collected (ISO 8601 format recommended, e.g., 2026-08-18).

latitude.descr: Sampling site latitude in decimal degrees; valid range -90 to 90.

longitude.descr: Sampling site longitude in decimal degrees; valid range -180 to 180.

depth_m.descr: Collection depth in meters below sea surface (m).

water_temperature_c.descr: In situ water temperature at the sampling depth in degrees Celsius (°C).

biome_type.descr: Broad biome classification of the sampling location, e.g., open ocean, coral reef, coastal shelf, deep sea, estuary.

environmental_feature.descr: Specific environmental feature or site descriptor relevant to the sample, e.g., proximity to hydrothermal vent, upwelling zone, oxygen minimum zone, seamount, river plume.

near_hydrothermal_vent.descr: Whether the sampling site is near a hydrothermal vent (true/false).

salinity_psu.descr: Optional in situ salinity at the sampling depth in practical salinity units (PSU).

dissolved_oxygen_mg_l.descr: Optional dissolved oxygen concentration at the sampling depth in milligrams per liter (mg/L).

sampling_platform.descr: Platform used to collect the sample, e.g., research vessel, CTD rosette, autonomous platform, submersible.

collection_method.descr: Method used to obtain the microbial sample, e.g., filtration, Niskin bottle, pumping, plankton tow.

ocean_region.descr: Higher-level oceanic region or basin where the sample was collected, e.g., Pacific Ocean, Atlantic Ocean, Indian Ocean, Southern Ocean, Arctic Ocean.
